D/ DN GR[---] NVS PP AVG ; D/ VRBS ROMA

Silver coin. Siliqua of Gratian (367-383), Urbs Roma issue of 367-375, Reece period 19; chipped with loss of one quarter of the flan. Obverse description: Bust draped pearl diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN GR[---] NVS PP AVG. Reverse description: Roma enthroned left holding vertical spear, Nike on globe on outstretched right hand. Obverse inscription: VRBS ROMA. Diameter:…
